references: Current native title screenshot for backdrop/composition

plans.name: Ivory Heraldry
plans.direction: Bold ivory cutout heraldic symbols, shaped like small carved stamps with broad silhouettes and tiny cyan inlays. A softly pointed arch, crescent, open folio, rosette, doorway, sword and return-arrow family. Strong fantasy serif labels with wedge serifs echo the approved logo; no delicate hairline lettering. A narrow broken-arch top detail and a restrained ivory/gold frame. Midnight ink surfaces; selected row uses a compact ivory bracket and pale cyan glow. Visually refined, spacious, confident, simple.
plans.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished GAME UI ART-DIRECTION BOARD for Blob to Blade, with THREE clearly separated large previews: a main menu, a Settings panel, and one eight-icon set. Landscape 16:10 board at high resolution; generous separation, no clipping. Label the three previews MAIN MENU, SETTINGS, ICONS in the board margin only.
REFERENCE 1: existing main menu, used ONLY for the rainy blue ruined-gate pixel-art backdrop, white-haired character at the right, left-aligned logo/menu composition, and required navigation. Redesign its bland thin-font/line-icon treatment substantially.
REFERENCE 2: the approved Blob to Blade logo. Preserve its cream fantasy lettering, cyan crescent, arch and tiny slime as closely as possible. It remains at upper left in the main-menu preview, never centered. Do not invent another logo or words.
Layout: the main-menu screenshot takes the upper-left approximately 62% of the board, at 16:9 ratio. A fully readable enlarged Settings design takes the right approximately 34%, top to near bottom. Along the bottom-left is a generous icon specimen strip in two rows of four, each icon large enough to inspect with a small short label underneath. Keep these three previews distinct, not overlapping. The board background is neutral near-black navy.
Main menu exact text: Continue; Ruined Outpost (small subtitle); New Journey; Settings; Quit. Continue is selected. Four actions total, at left below the logo; the beautiful gate remains unobstructed. Use a subtle frame only. No Select/Enter instruction footer.
Settings exact text: Settings; Close; Master volume 100%; Sound effects 100%; Dialogue 100%; Music 25%; Reduce flashes; Mute all audio; Back. Show four sliders and two unchecked boxes, sensible readable spacing, no clipped labels.
Icons: Gate, Map, Settings, Exit, Play, Book, Sound, Back. Eight individually designed, clearly readable glyphs in one cohesive family. They must also appear at appropriate scale in the main menu and Settings. Strong silhouettes; distinctive fantasy artifacts, crafted to complement the approved logo. Not a generic web-dashboard icon library.
Art direction: Bold ivory cutout heraldic symbols, shaped like small carved stamps with broad silhouettes and tiny cyan inlays. A softly pointed arch, crescent, open folio, rosette, doorway, sword and return-arrow family. Strong fantasy serif labels with wedge serifs echo the approved logo; no delicate hairline lettering. A narrow broken-arch top detail and a restrained ivory/gold frame. Midnight ink surfaces; selected row uses a compact ivory bracket and pale cyan glow. Visually refined, spacious, confident, simple.
Quality: professional indie fantasy RPG menu design; crisp intentional craft, sensible type hierarchy, all text legible, pixel-world backdrop preserved. The logo remains the strongest element. Different font/style choices are allowed for labels but they must complement the logo. Restrained ornament, no giant mascot, no unreadable pseudo-runes, no visual noise, no glossy mobile-game ads, no mockup laptop/device, no hand holding anything. These are proposal mockups, not production assets.

plans.name: Moonstone
plans.direction: Crisp hand-crafted pixel-fantasy stone interface with subtle physical depth. Slim blue-slate bevels, a few ivory corner stones and very sparse brass pins. Compact deep-set cyan gem selected states, textured stone only on narrow trim; content stays quiet navy. Icons are solid little bas-relief carved artifacts, not generic outline symbols, with two or three clear shades and a consistent pixel scale. Readable substantial fantasy serif labels match the logo, with slight carved shadows. No gigantic stone mascot, banners or ornate outer machinery.

plans.name: Midnight Folio
plans.direction: An elegant illuminated fantasy manuscript in midnight blue. A slightly irregular dark vellum panel, restrained engraved ivory corner flourishes and a narrow antique gold rule. Typography is a readable storybook serif with generous lowercase proportions and graceful capitals, heavier than the rejected thin Roman font. Icons are compact two-tone woodcut illustrations: moonlit gate, unfolded map with star, mechanical rosette, door, book, small bell and returning arrow. Ivory silhouettes with small navy internal cuts. Selected text gets a short turquoise underline and a tiny star, no broad app-style rectangle. Quiet hand-drawn personality.

plans.name: Astral Seal
plans.direction: A restrained magical fantasy interface informed by Raphael's golden analysis seal: tiny crescent-and-diamond medallions, subtle segmented gold circles, a minimal arched heading ornament and slender gold border, on near-black blue. Icons are compact solid gold sigils with cyan cores and a different meaningful silhouette for each action, not rings containing generic line icons. Main menu selections have a small revolving-seal-like static ornament at the left and warm ivory labels. Settings sliders resemble delicate engraved gold channels with cyan crystal endpoints. Strong high contrast fantasy serif lettering. Magical, legible, not futuristic sci-fi or busy.

plans.name: Enamel Relic
plans.direction: A polished collectible-fantasy interface made from matte dark-blue enamel and softly beveled antique ivory metal. Small shield/arch medallion icons, each with unique bold inset pictogram and a tiny turquoise highlight. Use gentle physical depth, a compact sculpted header tab, clean ivory separators and a very narrow embossed frame. Main menu is left aligned with generous spacing and restrained rounded-wedge selection plate behind only the active item. Lettering is warm bold fantasy serif with distinctive swash-free capitals, harmonious with the approved logo. Strong silhouettes, artisan finish, controlled detail, no excessive filigree.
